about: Every SDK's query builder writes these statements from these steps: the text and the values, a bool as SQLite keeps it, 0 or 1. A condition is {equal: {column: value}}, {sql: [text, ...values]}, {or: [conditions]}, {and: [conditions]} or {has: [column, value]}. A row, and an update's columns, are [name, value] pairs, in their order. An include step is [name, {table, steps}], the query whose rows the row holds under the name.

queries.name: equal values in the order of their names, a group of alternatives, an order and a limit
queries.text: select * from "orders" where "deleted" = ? and "status" = ? and (amount >= ? or "priority" = ?) order by "created_at" desc limit cast(? as integer)

queries.name: a piece of SQL beside others goes in parentheses
queries.text: select * from "orders" where "tenant_id" = ? and (total >= ? or total is null)

queries.name: a piece of SQL alone stands as it is
queries.text: select * from "orders" where total between ? and ?

queries.name: null is is null
queries.text: select * from "documents" where "deleted_at" is null

queries.name: a list is in, one value of any length
queries.text: select * from "orders" where "status" in (select value from json_each(?))

queries.name: an empty list finds nothing, and is the same statement
queries.text: select * from "orders" where "status" in (select value from json_each(?))

queries.name: groups inside groups, their values in the order they are written
queries.text: select * from "documents" where (("owner_id" = ? or "is_public" = ?) and deleted_at is null)

queries.name: a piece with an or of its own, inside a group, goes in parentheses
queries.text: select * from "documents" where ((owner_id = ? or is_public = 1) and "deleted" = ?)

queries.name: an empty or finds nothing, and an empty and everything
queries.text: select * from "orders" where 0 and 1

queries.name: a ? in a string or a comment is not a placeholder
queries.text:
select * from "notes" where title <> '?' -- why?
 and id = ?

queries.name: a join without select reads the first table's columns
queries.text: select "o".* from "orders" as "o" join "users" as "u" on u.id = o.user_id where "u"."email" = ?

queries.name: a left join's condition keeps its values in its on
queries.text: select o.id, o.total, u.email from "orders" as "o" left join "users" as "u" on u.id = o.user_id and u.active = ?

queries.name: a select, its groups and a condition on them
queries.text: select user_id, sum(total) as total from "orders" group by "user_id" having sum(total) > ?

queries.name: a name a request chooses is quoted, each part on its own
queries.text: select * from "orders" order by "a""b" desc, "u"."created_at" asc

queries.name: a limit and an offset compile once
queries.text: select * from "orders" limit cast(? as integer) offset cast(? as integer)

queries.name: an offset without a limit
queries.text: select * from "orders" limit -1 offset cast(? as integer)

queries.name: a JSON list holding a value
queries.text: select * from "notes" where exists (select 1 from json_each("tags") where value = ?)

queries.name: an update sets values and pieces of SQL, where its condition says
queries.text: update "notes" set "done" = ?, "views" = views + 1 where "id" = ?

queries.name: a delete deletes where its condition says
queries.text: delete from "notes" where created_at < ?

queries.name: rows inserted as one statement, given back as the file keeps them
queries.text: insert into "notes" ("id", "title") values (?, ?), (?, ?) returning *

queries.name: an upsert sets only what it names, on the row its owner holds
queries.text: insert into "notes" ("id", "title", "author_id") values (?, ?, ?) on conflict ("id") do update set "title" = excluded."title" where "author_id" = ? returning *

queries.name: a count counts every match, without the order and the limit
queries.text: select count(*) from "orders" where "status" = ?

queries.name: an included query's rows as literals in its row, in its order, its limit a row's
queries.text: select "u".*, (select group_concat('(' || case when typeof("id") = 'text' and instr(cast("id" as blob), x'00') > 0 then 'T' || quote(cast("id" as blob)) else quote("id") end || ',' || case when typeof("title") = 'text' and instr(cast("title" as blob), x'00') > 0 then 'T' || quote(cast("title" as blob)) else quote("title") end || ')', ',' order by "$o1" desc) from (select p.id, p.title, "p"."id" as "$o1" from "posts" as "p" where p.author_id = u.id order by "p"."id" desc limit cast(? as integer))) as "posts" from "users" as "u" where "u"."active" = ?

queries.name: an included query beside a select, its column named by as, its values before the row's own
queries.text: select u.id, u.name, (select group_concat('(' || case when typeof("id") = 'text' and instr(cast("id" as blob), x'00') > 0 then 'T' || quote(cast("id" as blob)) else quote("id") end || ',' || case when typeof("status") = 'text' and instr(cast("status" as blob), x'00') > 0 then 'T' || quote(cast("status" as blob)) else quote("status") end || ')', ',') from (select o.id, upper(o.status) as status from "orders" as "o" where o.user_id = u.id and o.total > ? limit cast(? as integer))) as "orders" from "users" as "u" where "u"."id" = ?
